symbol_descriptions: Initial catalytic velocity of the enzyme at a given substrate concentration
derivation_notes: Michaelis-Menten kinetics derived from the quasi-steady-state approximation of the enzyme-substrate complex, giving a hyperbolic saturation relation between velocity and substrate concentration.
scenario_text: A purified enzyme is assayed at fixed enzyme concentration while the substrate concentration is varied across a wide range. The initial reaction velocity is measured immediately after mixing, before appreciable substrate depletion. The response rises steeply at low substrate and levels off toward a maximum at high substrate. The experimenter records instantaneous velocities under independently prepared substrate conditions.

dependent_variable.description: Initial catalytic velocity of the enzyme at a given substrate concentration
